Figure 48 Leader Board Weekly Reset Back-end Sequence Diagram 
The event bridge is set to trigger the leaderboard scan once per week. The 
leaderboard scan lambda will cycle through all leaderboard IDs and push them 
onto a queue, each of these items will in turn trigger the update leaderboard 
lambda. For the given leaderboard ID, the lambda will then update each 
participant’s state, and their stats based on their positioning. 
4.8 Deployment and Quality Assurance with DevOps 
The deployment strategy for the project will be focused on a streamlined 
development and deployment process by integrating Continuous Integration (CI) 
and Continuous Deployment (CD). The projects code will be divided into two, 
first a repository for the projects Cloud Development Kit (CDK), and second the 
software code itself. The CDK, will be defined in TypeScript, and will outline the 
cloud infrastructure. This whole strategy to deploy with infrastructure as code 
(IaC) over the AWS console, highlights the projects alignment with the AWS best 
practices (AWS, n.d.). 
The deployment strategy utilised AWS RDS for storing the ECS’s Docker images, 
and AWS S3 for the lambdas’ zipped source files. Bash scripts will be used to 
rapidly automate the upload and compilation process of images and zip files,
